code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if 0 < r < h - 1 and len(set(row)) == 1:
            candidates.append((abs(r - (h - 1) / 2), "row", r))
    for c in range(w):
        if 0 < c < w - 1 and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1:
            candidates.append((abs(c - (w - 1) / 2), "col", c))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("No panel divider found")
    _, axis, divider = min(candidates)
    if axis == "row":
        a, b = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
        width = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        shared = set(sum(a, [])) & set(sum(b, []))
        color = next(iter(shared))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(min(len(a), len(b)))]
    a = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    b = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(sum(a, [])) & set(sum(b, []))
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(min(len(a[r]), len(b[r])))] for r in range(h)]
